content: Converge the repository layout on patterns from comparable open-source substrates (Mesa/Gallium frontends-drivers-winsys-auxiliary, Wine's dlls/<name>/unix single-directory two-image split, crosvm rutabaga_gfx neutral protocol with pluggable backends), resolving the review findings: undecided transport half placement, unenforced dependency direction, centralized unit tests, and placeholder directories that contradict the create-on-implementation rule.

D0010: every transport owns exactly one directory split into a C17 client half (application closure, role transport-client, C-only directory rule applies) and a C++20 worker half (daemon side, role transport-worker). The halves never include each other's headers and communicate only through contracts/protocol, contracts/shared, and for cdev the kernel UAPI. Amended: transports/README.md plus the memfd, cdev, and vfio-user READMEs.

D0011: component dependency edges are machine-checked. cmake/MetaFluxComponentGraph.cmake registers every boundary target (component id, role, language) and writes metaflux-component-graph.json at configure time; tools/check-component-graph.py fails on any edge outside the role whitelist, any C-to-CXX link, and any client-side link into the daemon. Wired as CTest metaflux.architecture.component-graph in every test preset. Failure path verified by injecting an illegal compat-provider to backend-runtime edge, which produced two errors.

Test two-tier rule enforced: tests/README.md already declared that component unit tests stay beside their owners, so runtime_smoke.cpp moved to runtime/core/tests/ keeping the stable CTest name metaflux.unit.runtime; tests/ retains cross-component qualification and gains the architecture label.

Placeholder directories pruned per the create-on-implementation rule: plugins/backend/vulkan, services/vfio-userd, and services/compiler-worker removed; ownership boundaries preserved in docs/roadmap.md with milestone references. Build references were grepped clean before removal.

docs/architecture/repo-layout.md (Verified) added: three-axis taxonomy, dependency-direction map, where-to-put-things table, and prior-art references. Linked from README.md, the architecture index, and the component map.
Reconfigure, build, and test across presets: dev, release, asan, provider, cuda-only, nvml-only; then run tools/check-agent-records.py.

dev 15/15, release 15/15, asan 15/15, provider 10/10, cuda-only 6/6, nvml-only 6/6; the new metaflux.architecture.component-graph test passed in every preset; agent records passed validation. Component graph at dev: 9 components, 9 edges, all legal.
